criteria.detail: 287 posts on 5 rails; 4 of them are filed under a date at which their own page layout did not exist yet, caught on which fields are present and not on any value (2020-01-04, 2020-01-05, 2020-01-11, 2020-01-12). Dropping them takes the zero state from 3 separate runs to 1, so this is not a cosmetic clean-up: unfixed, the series appears to lose the number twice in January 2020 and get it back
criteria.name: B62-1

criteria.detail: three states fall out of the series' own signatures with no date supplied: a value that changes, a value that repeats to the cent, and a value printed as zero. live 120 posts, longest run 101; stale 17 posts, longest run 16; absent 146 posts, longest run 146. The last run is absent and it is the longest of its kind, running 2020-08-05 to 2021-07-23 and never returning to live, which is what separates it from a short repeat structurally rather than by a threshold
criteria.name: B62-2

criteria.detail: the publisher posts across all three states: 120 live, 17 stale, 146 zero, from 2019-07-22 to 2021-07-23. The archive has one big hole, 63 days from 2020-02-27 to 2020-04-30, and it covers 1 of the three events (2020-03-15); the other 2 fall on days the publisher posted, which is why this station reads those two and not that one
criteria.name: B62-3

criteria.detail: on the very posts where the target is frozen and then zero, the same publisher prints other rates that move: over the 16 frozen posts USD/ZWL/zimrates.com runs 90.00 to 98.00, USD/ZWL/interbank runs 65.87 to 76.76; over the 146 zero posts USD/ZWL/zimrates.com runs 95.00 to 135.00, USD/ZWL/interbank runs 80.46 to 86.79. The channel is demonstrably up, so what changed is the thing it carries and not the carrying
criteria.name: B62-4

criteria.detail: the boundaries the series found on its own are absent from 2020-08-05, stale from 2020-07-13, with the last live post 2020-07-10; the externally dated events are 2020-03-15 transfer edge suspended, both prices still produced, 2020-06-29 Harare price stops being produced, 2020-08-03 Harare leg removed, trading resumes without it. The freeze begins at the first post after trading stops and the zero begins at the first post after the resumption that left the share out, and neither date was used to define either state
criteria.name: B62-5

criteria.detail: the archive has 0 posts between the last live value of February and the first of April 30, and 0 of them carry the target, so the transfer-edge suspension of 2020-03-15 is not observable here; this station reads the second and third levels and does not claim the first
